about_the_game:
'Destroy This Block' (DEMO) is a simple 2D puzzle game about guiding a bomb to the target block through restrictive paths and dangerous obstacles before time runs out. This demo version includes 10 levels. The full game has over 150 levels.

The bomb's movement conserves momentum in a zero gravity environment, making this highly challenging at times.
